fields.Name: T364 - Component Run Live Preview
fields.Description: Exercises the live in-browser component sandbox (mj-react-component mount + viewport presets + error overlay) — the core Component Studio capability, exercised nowhere else.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Component Studio app (Components section), click a component card in the left browser to expand it, then click its 'Run' button. Wait for the center Preview pane to mount and render the live component (React-based). On success a live rendered component appears in the preview area and a viewport-size selector (mobile/tablet/desktop icons) becomes available in the preview toolbar; a running indicator/badge may also appear. Pages and component compilation can take 10-30s in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the component render live (or a clear inline error overlay with a Retry/Ask-AI-to-Fix affordance) is success — you do NOT need to interact further.

judgeValidationCriteria: Expanding a component card reveals a 'Run' action and clicking it starts the component
The center Preview pane renders the live component AND a viewport selector (mobile/tablet/desktop) appears, OR a clear inline error overlay with Retry/Ask-AI-to-Fix is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
